dave 20 minutes ago | prev [–]

I maintained a plugin for this editor for six years and the thing nobody mentions is how much of the start-up time belongs to plugins like mine. We all registered our commands eagerly because the documentation told us to, and by the time the lazy activation hooks arrived there were four thousand extensions in the registry that nobody was ever going to rewrite. Most of them still load on start-up today, and the benchmark would look very different with them installed.
